source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.3, phase, lead and lag, and phasors (PDF 90-92).

blocks.text: Woh angle θ jo batata hai ke kisi lamhe par alternating voltage ya current ki qeemat kya hai, phase kehlata hai. Voltage aur current ki instantaneous qeematein:
Yani jo angle alternating miqdar ki qeemat deta hai, woh phase hai (θ = ωt).
Points A, B, C, D aur E ke phase 0, π/2, π, 3π/2 aur 2π hain (Fig. 17.5(a)). Is tarah AC cycle ka har point ek phase se pehchana jata hai.

blocks.alt: +Vo aur -Vo ke darmiyan alternating voltage ka aik sabz chakkar. Mehwar theta = omega t par nuqte A, B, C, D aur E phases 0, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi par hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (a): AC chakkar ka har nuqta aik phase hai (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.5(a) ke axis par '2θ = ωt' chhapa hai; sahi θ = ωt hai (text bhi yahi kehta hai). A = 0, B = π/2 (sab se oopar), C = π, D = 3π/2 (sab se neeche), E = 2π.
Figs. 17.5(b) aur 17.5(c) dekhein: t = 0 par angle θ bhi 0° hai. t = 0 par phase angle θ ki qeemat ko AC miqdar ka initial phase (shuru ka phase) kehte hain. In equations ke mutabiq:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin θ   (17.9)

blocks.text: voltage V aur current I dono ka initial phase zero hai, yani dono ek saath chalte hain (in phase). Lekin kai baar current aur voltage in phase nahi hote; un ke phase mein farq hota hai. Maslan voltage V ka initial phase zero ho aur current I ka initial phase φ ho (Fig. 17.5(b)). Is ki equations:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ)

blocks.text: t = 0 par voltage V = 0 hai lekin current pehle se positive hai: I = Iₒ sin φ. Matlab current φ angle pehle zero se guzar chuka tha. Is liye kehte hain ke current voltage se φ angle aage (leading) hai (Fig. 17.5(b)). Angle φ voltage aur current ka phase difference (phase ka farq) hai.
Isi tarah current ka initial phase voltage ke muqable mein negative bhi ho sakta hai (Fig. 17.5(c)). Is ki equations:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ)

blocks.text: Ab t = 0 par V zero hai lekin current negative hai: I = −Iₒ sin φ. Current voltage ke φ angle baad zero tak pohanchega. Is liye current voltage se φ angle peeche (lagging) hai. Angle φ, V aur I ka phase difference hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan current ki qeemat '(I – sin φ)' chhapti hai, jo adhoori hai. Sahi I = −Iₒ sin φ hai (I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ) mein θ = 0 rakhein).

blocks.alt: t ke muqable do graph. (b) Positive phase: surkh current I = Io sin(theta + phi) t = 0 se phi pehle shuru hota, t = 0 par Io sin phi hai aur sabz voltage V se pehle +Io par pohanchta hai. (c) Negative phase: current I = Io sin(theta - phi) t = 0 par -Io sin phi hai aur V ke phi baad sifar paar karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (b), (c): (b) current voltage se aage, (c) current voltage se peeche (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (b), (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figs. 17.5(b) aur (c) mein t = 0 par current ki qeemat 'Iₒ sin θ' likhi hai. t = 0 par θ = 0 hota hai, is liye sahi qeemat (b) mein Iₒ sin φ aur (c) mein −Iₒ sin φ hai; khaake mein yahi likha hai. Jo wave apni peak par pehle pohanche, woh aage (lead) hai.
Alternating miqdar ko vector se dikhana
Alternating miqdar ko ek anticlockwise ghoomte hue vector se dikha sakte hain, agar yeh shartein poori hon:

items: Vector ki lambai kisi scale par alternating miqdar ki peak ya rms qeemat dikhaye.
Jis lamhe alternating miqdar zero ho aur positive taraf barh rahi ho, us waqt vector horizontal (leta hua) ho.
Vector usi angular frequency se ghoome jo alternating miqdar ki angular frequency hai.

blocks.text: Fig. 17.5(d) mein voltage ki wave current ki wave se 90° (π/2 rad) aage hai. Fig. 17.5(e) mein vector OI current ki peak ya rms qeemat hai, jise reference (hawala) liya gaya hai. OV voltage ki peak ya rms qeemat hai, jo current se π/2 rad (90°) aage hai. Dono vectors angular frequency ω se anticlockwise ghoomte hain.

blocks.alt: (d) Surkh voltage V aur sabz current I waqt ke saath; V apni chotti par I se chauthai chakkar, pi/2, pehle pohanchta hai. (e) O se vector diagram: OI ufqi (current) aur OV amudi (voltage), darmiyan 90 darje ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5 (d), (e): (d) voltage V current I se pi/2 aage; (e) vector diagram OI aur OV, V aage 90 darje (kitab ki Figure 17.5 (d), (e) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Agar I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2) aur V = Vₒ sin ωt ho to kaun aage hai, aur kitna?
blocks.explanation: Current voltage se π/2 (90°) aage hai.

items: Phase θ = ωt batata hai ke cycle mein hum kahan hain.
I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ): current φ aage (lead); I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ): current φ peeche (lag).
AC miqdar = anticlockwise ghoomta vector (phasor): lambai = peak ya rms, raftar = ω.
